title: Multi-Language Stores
description: Learn how to create multi-language stores, translate content, and serve customers in their preferred language.
content:
Multi-Language Stores

Create multi-language stores to serve customers worldwide in their preferred language, improving user experience and expanding your market reach.

Supported Languages

Tijraa supports 22+ languages:

  • English, Arabic, Spanish, French, German
  • Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish
  • Chinese (Simplified & Traditional)
  • Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Polish
  • Hebrew, Persian, Estonian, Indonesian
  • Romanian, Thai, and more

Enabling Multi-Language

Step 1: Access Language Settings

Navigate to Store Settings → Languages.

Step 2: Enable Languages

Select the languages you want to support for your store.

Step 3: Set Default Language

Choose the default language for your store.

Step 4: Configure Language Switcher

Enable language switcher in header or footer.

Translating Content

Translate store content:

  • Product names and descriptions
  • Category names
  • Page content
  • Blog posts
  • Email templates
  • Store settings

Language Switcher

Add language switcher:

  • Header menu
  • Footer
  • Sidebar
  • Dropdown menu
  • Flag icons

Automatic Translation

Use AI-powered translation:

  • Auto-translate products
  • Auto-translate categories
  • Auto-translate pages
  • Review and edit translations

Manual Translation

Translate manually for accuracy:

  • Edit translations directly
  • Use translation interface
  • Hire professional translators
  • Import translations

RTL Support

Right-to-left language support:

  • Arabic
  • Hebrew
  • Persian
  • Automatic RTL layout

SEO for Multi-Language

Optimize for search engines:

  • Language-specific URLs
  • Hreflang tags
  • Language-specific sitemaps
  • Localized content

Best Practices

  • Start with most important languages
  • Use professional translations
  • Test all languages
  • Keep translations updated
  • Consider cultural differences
  • Optimize for each language
